director.label: Leadership
director.name: Dipl. ing. Stipe Barišić
director.title: Director and founder
director.bio1: With 20 years of experience in passive fire protection, Stipe Barišić is one of the leading experts in Croatia and the region. He built his career as director of the Promat G.m.b.H. representative office in Croatia and as technical director of Promat SEE.
director.bio2: He founded FSB in 2013, building on a proven business model — consulting on the optimal choice of passive fire protection measures and executing demanding projects, with more than 300 successfully completed projects.
director.bio3: He regularly educates the professional community through seminars and lectures, including the Croatian Fire Safety Forum.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: FSB d.o.o.
about.description: We build trust through excellence in passive fire protection.
about.storyParagraph1: FSB d.o.o. was founded to provide first-class passive fire protection services on the Croatian market. From the very beginning, our focus has been on quality, expertise and reliability.
about.storyParagraph2: We deliver projects for the most demanding clients — from residential buildings and healthcare facilities to tunnels and industrial plants.
about.storyParagraph3: All systems must work as a whole — that is why, alongside execution, we provide consulting through every phase of the project. Through our own brand FSB Doors we also offer our own product: fire-rated doors and metalwork.
about.missionStatement: To ensure the highest level of fire protection for all types of buildings by combining expert knowledge, quality materials and professional execution.
